about: Mor Ul Rek (Karamja steps K2.1 to K2.3): TzHaar-Ket-Zuh at the north bank, the three outer shopkeepers (K2.2), the barrier guards, inner bank, shops, elders and level 221 TzHaar-Ket (K2.3), the infernal eel spots (K2.4), and the city's attackable TzHaar-Hur, -Mej, -Xil and level 149 -Ket at the Wiki's spawn points (the pickpocketable TzHaar-Hur, 7682 to 7687, are thieving-far.json's) (its TzHaar-Hur, TzHaar-Mej, TzHaar-Xil and TzHaar-Ket pages' maps, read 2026-11-18), each with the look of the nearest one in mejrs's NPCList_OSRS. The shopkeepers are step K2.2; the inner city's level 221 TzHaar-Ket, banker and guards K2.3; the Fight Cave's and Inferno's TzHaar the Fight Caves thread's.
